video_title: 72 Hours Straight with Knicks' Champ Deuce McBride

quotes.speaker: Deuce McBride
quotes.summary_phrase: Deuce McBride on his journey from G League to NBA champion
quotes.excerpt: I've seen me grow from a guy driving up to Bridgeport, Connecticut to go play in a G League game.
quotes.quote: Y'all see me grow from a guy driving up to Bridgeport, Connecticut to go play in a G League game. I never let that waver and I feel like that's a New York mentality. People are going to get it out the mud, going to do whatever they have to do to hustle to bring home the right stuff. Days I didn't want to do it, days I was sad, days I was disappointed, man, to y'all, y'all picked me up. Y'all kept me going, the fans that didn't even know who I was yelling Deuce from the beginning, it's been crazy.

quotes.speaker: Deuce McBride
quotes.summary_phrase: Deuce McBride on the discipline required to win another championship
quotes.excerpt: My only off-season goal, do whatever I got to do to win another.
quotes.quote: My only off-season goal, do whatever I got to do to win another. Now I know how hard it is. Now I know what it takes, the focus, the discipline.

quotes.speaker: Deuce McBride
quotes.summary_phrase: Deuce McBride on the Knicks' collective focus and championship potential
quotes.excerpt: I think we have a special chance to do something special again next year.
quotes.quote: I kept saying last year in interviews, I'm like, yo, people are locked in differently this summer. When you lose and you're so close to a championship, you've got to lock in differently. I think we have a special chance to do something special again next year because we're going to celebrate this, enjoy this, but we're locked in, and I've never seen such a locked-in crew.

quotes.speaker: Deuce McBride
quotes.summary_phrase: Deuce McBride on the emotional weight of winning an NBA championship
quotes.excerpt: It feels like something was definitely checked off my checklist.
quotes.quote: It feels like something was definitely checked off my checklist. That feeling, that memory of just, man, all the work I put in, all the struggle, success. I'm thankful for it, for God blessing me with the abilities to be able to play this game at such a high level, to put me on a team with such great people. All those memories are just flooding my mind, the time I'm working out with my brother in the backyard, it's just crazy.
